import FreeCAD
import Part

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Get the existing sketches
sketch_a = doc.getObject("Sketch")      # Line from (-20, 0, 0) to (20, 0, 0)
sketch_b = doc.getObject("Sketch001")   # Line from (-20, 20, 0) to (20, 20, 0)

# Get the edges from the sketches
edge_a = sketch_a.Shape.Edges[0]
edge_b = sketch_b.Shape.Edges[0]

print(f"Edge A: {edge_a.Vertexes[0].Point} to {edge_a.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Edge B: {edge_b.Vertexes[0].Point} to {edge_b.Vertexes[1].Point}")

# Define the four vertices of the quadrilateral
v1 = FreeCAD.Vector(-20, 0, 0)    # Bottom-left
v2 = FreeCAD.Vector(20, 0, 0)     # Bottom-right
v3 = FreeCAD.Vector(20, 20, 0)    # Top-right
v4 = FreeCAD.Vector(-20, 20, 0)   # Top-left

# Create the two side edges using Part.LineSegment
side_edge_left = Part.LineSegment(v1, v4)  # From (-20, 0, 0) to (-20, 20, 0)
side_edge_right = Part.LineSegment(v2, v3)  # From (20, 0, 0) to (20, 20, 0)

# Convert to edges
edge_left = side_edge_left.toShape()
edge_right = side_edge_right.toShape()

print(f"\nLeft side edge: {edge_left.Vertexes[0].Point} to {edge_left.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Right side edge: {edge_right.Vertexes[0].Point} to {edge_right.Vertexes[1].Point}")

# Now we have 4 edges:
# 1. edge_a: (-20, 0, 0) to (20, 0, 0) - bottom
# 2. edge_right: (20, 0, 0) to (20, 20, 0) - right side
# 3. edge_b: (-20, 20, 0) to (20, 20, 0) - top (but direction is wrong for closed loop)
# 4. edge_left: (-20, 0, 0) to (-20, 20, 0) - left side (direction also needs checking)

# For a proper closed wire, edges should connect end-to-end
# Let's create edges in proper order:
# Start at v1 (-20, 0, 0), go to v2 (20, 0, 0), then v3 (20, 20, 0), then v4 (-20, 20, 0), back to v1

# Bottom edge (already exists as edge_a): v1 -> v2
bottom_edge = edge_a

# Right edge (need to create): v2 -> v3  
right_edge = Part.LineSegment(v2, v3).toShape()

# Top edge (need to reverse or create new): v3 -> v4
top_edge = Part.LineSegment(v3, v4).toShape()

# Left edge (need to create): v4 -> v1
left_edge = Part.LineSegment(v4, v1).toShape()

print(f"\nBottom edge: {bottom_edge.Vertexes[0].Point} to {bottom_edge.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Right edge: {right_edge.Vertexes[0].Point} to {right_edge.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Top edge: {top_edge.Vertexes[0].Point} to {top_edge.Vertexes[1].Point}")
print(f"Left edge: {left_edge.Vertexes[0].Point} to {left_edge.Vertexes[1].Point}")

# Create a wire from these 4 edges
wire = Part.Wire([bottom_edge, right_edge, top_edge, left_edge])
print(f"\nWire created: {wire.ShapeType}, isValid: {wire.isValid()}")

# Create a planar face from the wire
face = Part.Face(wire)
print(f"Face created: {face.ShapeType}, isValid: {face.isValid()}")

# Add the face to the document as a Part::Feature
part_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "QuadrilateralFace")
part_obj.Shape = face
doc.recompute()

# Also add the wire as a separate object for reference
wire_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "QuadrilateralWire")
wire_obj.Shape = wire
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("\nDocument saved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Verify the save
print("\nVerification:")
print(f"  Document objects: {[obj.Name for obj in doc.Objects]}")
print(f"  Face area: {face.Area}")
print(f"  Wire length: {wire.Length}")

EOF
python3 /tmp/create_quadrilateral.py
"}
